title: Pagination
summary: Page navigation: numbered with ellipses, a range summary, a page-size select, a simple previous and next form, or load more. On a phone the numbers collapse to previous, Page N of M and next.

props.name: pages
props.description: Page count; 0 derives it from total and pageSize.

props.name: total
props.description: Item count; enables the range summary.

props.name: sizes
props.description: Options for the page-size select, for example [10, 25, 50, 100]; empty hides the select.

props.name: siblings
props.description: Pages either side of the current one.

props.name: boundary
props.description: Pages always shown at each end.

props.name: edges
props.description: Show First and Last buttons beside Previous and Next.

events.name: pk-page
events.description: A page was chosen. Cancel to keep the current page (a server-driven grid sets page itself).

events.name: pk-page-size
events.description: The page-size select changed. Cancel to keep the size.

parts.name: summary
parts.description: The range text, such as 21-30 of 95.

cssProperties.name: --pk-pagination-size
cssProperties.description: Button size; the touch target on a phone.

methods.name: pageWindow(current, total, options)
methods.description: The numbers and gaps to show.

methods.name: pageRange(page, size, total)
methods.description: First and last item on a page.

a11y: A nav landmark with a label; the current page has aria-current=page and every number button has a name ("Page 3"); previous and next are disabled at the ends; the ellipsis is decorative. Buttons are 44px on a phone.

examples.title: Numbered with summary and page size
